data.title: Ramp Investigation
data.description: Plan, predict, and collect evidence about how a box moves up a ramp.

challenges.title: What does your evidence show?
challenges.brief: Investigate how the ramp surface affects the push needed to start the box moving uphill.
challenges.hint: Use both trial records. Tell what changed and compare the measured push.
challenges.explainOnSolve: A controlled comparison connects a change in one condition to the measured result.
